staging_allocation_bytes.expression: merged P destination matrices or actual Program staging allocations

final_stream_synchronizations.expression: 2 streams per merged rank, otherwise 3; wall timer includes synchronize()

identity.timing_scope: host steady_clock around backend.execute() plus backend.synchronize()

comparison_context.timing_scope: host steady_clock around backend.execute() plus backend.synchronize()

one_cta_per_sm_reference.meaning: reference packing only; ignores scheduling, stalls and serial progress

m_tiles.expression: ceil(GEMM_M/64); GEMM_M=P*M for merged, otherwise M

partition_a_bytes.scope: one K partition, all output tiles

partition_b_bytes.scope: one K partition, all output tiles

logical_a_load_bytes.expression: 2*GEMM_M*K*n_tiles; q disjoint K partitions cover K once

extra_output_bytes.expression: read+write minus the q=1 final write

epilogue_boundaries_per_tile.expression: q-1 ordered partition boundaries; not elapsed time
